what_it_is: how well the question could be answered from what the robot itself saw
why_it_changes_how_every_accuracy_number: it says the information is present and the model is not using it, so the bottleneck is not observation. Every accuracy number in this wave should be read as a fraction of this, not of 100%.
measured_on: the eleven questions in the probe file with no leak anywhere, all of them after the return. ONE household.
how_much_weight_it_carries: eleven questions and one household, so an indication and not a result. It is recorded because it inverts an assumption held all night - that the limit was what the robot had seen - and because a wrong assumption about the bottleneck changes which arm is worth building, not just how a number reads.
what_it_does_not_say: nothing about the ten-home wave, nothing about any arm's notes, and nothing about the settled or disrupted windows: all eleven questions are after the return.
